sloka: अब्रवीद्विधिवत्कृत्वा तस्यातिथ्यं तपोधना ।कुशध्वजो मम पिता ब्रह्मर्षिरमितप्रभः ।बृहस्पतिसुतः श्रीमान्बुद्ध्या तुल्यो बृहस्पतेः ।। ७.१७.८ ॥
transliteration: abravīdvidhivatkṛtvā tasyātithyaṁ tapodhanā ।kuśadhvajo mama pitā brahmarṣiramitaprabhaḥ ।bṛhaspatisutaḥ śrīmānbuddhyā tulyo bṛhaspateḥ ।। 7.17.8 ॥

translations.english: Tell me everything, who am asking, for what reason is this exertion; thus spoken to by Ravana, that glorious maiden then replied.
